checks.coverage: Correct sequential fixture passes, deliberately wrong fixture fails, repaired fixture passes.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Binary control behavior verified; unspecified unknown-control behavior is not assigned an additional requirement.
implementation: One-bit positive-edge register: L loads R with priority, otherwise E shifts w, otherwise Q holds. Original ports preserved, no reset or extra latency introduced.
verification: Independent operation-based oracle checks initial unknown and hold behavior, every binary input combination from both stored values, load/shift conflicts, input-change stability, and falling-edge stability. Bounded timeout and fatal mismatch checks included.
static_review: Single always_ff driver, nonblocking register assignments, one-bit ports, no combinational latch or added pipeline. Initial snapshot preserved before development checks.
